alt: The Estadio Azteca (Estadio Banorte) in Mexico City, a 2026 FIFA World Cup venue, seen from the stands
story: FIFA's World Cup 2026 ticketing site accidentally sold about 60 fans tickets for $0, then cancelled them and told the fans to buy the same seats again at full price.
why_funny: The most lucrative World Cup ever, projected to make $11bn, built a checkout that gave seats away for free and then demanded the money back.
